review_method: All nine final 08485e packaged RHI PNGs were individually re-opened and directly visually inspected with view_image. PNG header dimensions and SHA-256 were independently read and matched to the final completed wrapper receipt; this is not a relabelling of the previous 205bdd review.
scope: 1920x1080, interface text scale 150%, resources/map, briefing and wire views for Apollo 12, SELENE and Mars; visible still-image content only.

receipt.note: The source commit is the receipt's baseline; its source fingerprint identifies the tested working-tree source. Packaged executable hash is authoritative; game_module_sha256 is null in this packaged receipt.

result: No material visible text clipping or control overlap found in these nine inspected frames. This is scoped visual acceptance, not a claim that every control or every scroll position was visually inspected.
cosmetic_limits: Faint underlying pause/HUD lettering remains visible through the panel but does not materially obscure the inspected foreground text.
Map callout leader lines cross in dense regions; numbered labels remain separated and readable.
scroll_limits: Resources frames intentionally scroll the map into view, so content above and below the scroll viewport is cropped. The visible map, legend and waypoint rows are readable.
Briefing frames show all three difficulty choices and the proposed/current budgets. Additional ledger rows and confirmation controls below the fold were not visually verified by these stills.
Wire frames show the actionable port rows and reset/source controls for rescue missions; footer text continues below the scroll viewport.

images.finding: Orbital basemap, cyan player marker, separate numbered star callouts, legend and visible waypoint rows are readable; scroll crop is intentional.
Wrapped navigation, all three difficulty buttons, selected Professional state and forecast/current resource text are readable; lower content requires scrolling.
Explicit read-only SELENE/ARES cable-matching context is readable; Apollo does not show active rescue wire-matching buttons.
Actual-position schematic is explicitly labelled; separate numbered callouts, player marker, map explanation and visible waypoint buttons are readable.
Difficulty choices, selected Professional profile and authored-budget explanation/forecast are readable; continued ledger rows are below the scroll fold.
All four labelled source/socket rows, selected source B, verified 1/4 state, reset and Science & Sources buttons are readable with text and colour cues.
Seven separated numbered map callouts and actual-position schematic explanation are readable. Visible waypoint rows and selected main objective remain clear despite crossing leader lines.
All difficulty choices, Professional not-confirmed status, 80 RU/0.8 MB/0.5 kg/384 gameplay oxygen-second proposal and current 480-second ledger are readable; confirmation is below the fold.
Isolated status, verified 1/4, all four source/socket labels, source B highlight, reset and Science & Sources buttons are visible and readable.

changes_during_review: Documentation only; no source, engine execution, screenshots or original receipt were modified.

superseded_review.note: Preserved byte-for-byte; its nine images were inspected separately before the final build review.

fixture_limit: These arranged review frames seed gameplay state for readable UI inspection. Ledger values here are displayed fixture values, not a measurement of mission endurance or a complete playthrough.
